verdict: The application install command returned a non-zero exit code. The installer itself encountered an error.
fix: Open the product-specific installer log (typically in %windir%\ccmcache\<guid>\ or %temp%\) and find the first failing step. Common root causes: missing prerequisite (.NET, VC runtime), insufficient permissions, conflicting software, pending reboot, or a corrupted download. If the exit code is 1618, another MSI is mid-install; if 1603, the MSI failed (keep reading ccmsetup.log or the per-product log).
